heading: 1. Writing style
text: Address the reader as "you" (or "learner(s)"), never "student" or "user". No contractions in instructional text — "do not", not "don't". Active voice and the Oxford comma — "DNA, RNA, and protein". Define acronyms on first use — spell it out the first time, then use the short form: "endoplasmic reticulum (ER)" first, "ER" after. Widely understood acronyms (DNA, RNA, PCR, ATP…) do not need defining

text: Each module gets an overview (with learning goals ) and a module summary (with key takeaways ). Each lecture gets an overview (with learning objectives ) and a lecture summary (with key takeaways ). Each assignment gets an overview and a summary page too (no takeaways required there). heading: 8. Formatting
text: No custom font, size, or color — let the platform's styling apply. Bold with the template's own bold formatting, not a colored/enlarged font. heading: 3. Dropdown
text: Use a dropdown only for a formatting reason — to complete a statement inline, fill cells in a table, or present a one-to-one match. If the question works as a standalone pick-one question, author it as Multiple Choice instead: a multiple choice lowers the cognitive load for the learner. heading: 4. Numerical input
text: Instruction: pick the phrase that matches the answer type: whole number → "Enter your answer as a whole number in the space provided." percentage → "Enter your answer as a percentage with no rounding. Do not include the percent symbol in your response." decimal → "Enter your answer as a decimal to two significant figures." Accepted range — required whenever the answer is not a single exact value.

heading: 5. Text / short answer
text: No special instruction phrase is required. Correct answer: give the accepted answer (matching is case-insensitive). Alternative correct answers — give them whenever they exist. List every acceptable variant (synonyms, spellings, abbreviations), e.g. accept both DNA and deoxyribonucleic acid . heading: Numerical: Answer-Format Instruction
text: prompts-numerical-answer-format · warning · static · default ✗ — Ensures numerical-input problems tell the learner how to format their answer. The expected phrase depends on the answer type: whole number ("Enter your answer as a whole number in the space provided."), percentage ("Enter your answer as a percentage with no rounding. Do not include the percent symbol in your response."), or decimal ("Enter your answer as a decimal to two significant figures.").

heading: Dropdown: "Use the drop-down options to …"
text: prompts-dropdown-instruction · warning · static · default ✗ — Ensures dropdown (option response) problems include a prompt beginning "Use the drop-down options to …" (the remainder is question-specific).

heading: Open-Ended: Auto-Credit Phrase
text: prompts-open-ended-credit-phrase · warning · static · default ✗ — Ensures open-ended one-sentence problems that auto-grade any non-empty answer as correct (a customresponse with a textline and an any-answer check) end with "Any thoughtful answer will receive credit; click the Show Answer button to check your thoughts."

heading: Answer Option Formatting
text: prompts-answer-option-format · warning · ai · default ✗ — Uses AI to check answer-choice capitalization and terminal punctuation. Options should start lowercase unless the option is a proper noun or a full sentence. A terminal period is expected only on full-sentence options.

heading: Avoid "PCR reaction"
text: bio-pcr-reaction · warning · static · default ✗ — Flags the redundant phrase "PCR reaction", including prefixed variants (qPCR, RT-PCR, ddPCR, real-time PCR) — the R in PCR already stands for "reaction".

heading: Avoid Possessives on Scientific Terms
text: bio-active-site-possessive · warning · static · default ✗ — Flags the possessive form of scientific terms (e.g. "protein's", "DNA's", "cell's", "gene's") regardless of the following word — prefer "the active site of the protein" over "the protein's active site".

heading: Dideoxy (Sanger) sequencing
text: bio-sanger-dideoxy · warning · static · default ✗ — Flags bare "Sanger sequencing"; the method should be introduced as "dideoxy (Sanger) sequencing".

heading: Address learners as "you"
text: bio-address-as-you · info · static · default ✗ — Flags "student"/"user" in prose in favor of addressing the reader directly as "you". Per faculty, "learner" is the accepted third-person term (used in Universal) and is not flagged.

heading: Italicize biological nomenclature
text: bio-italics-nomenclature · warning · ai · default ✗ — Uses AI to check that genus/species names, gene symbols, and restriction-enzyme prefixes are italicized, and that protein names are not. These are conventional typographic italics, not emphasis — use <i>, not <em>.

heading: Dominant/Recessive Describes the Trait
text: bio-phenotype-dominance · warning · static · default ✗ — Per faculty convention, a phenotype/trait is dominant or recessive — an allele, gene, or mutation is not. Flags "dominant"/"recessive" attached to "allele", "gene", or "mutation" (e.g. "the dominant allele") and suggests rephrasing (e.g. "the allele encoding the dominant trait"). "Dominant trait", "recessive phenotype", "dominant eye color" are correct and not flagged.

heading: No Custom Font Family
text: fonts-family-default · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures no inline font-family styles are applied. Custom fonts break the platform's consistent look and may not render correctly on all devices.

heading: No Custom Font Size
text: fonts-size-default · warning · static · default ✓ — Ensures no inline font-size styles are applied. Custom font sizes override the platform's responsive typography and can harm readability.

heading: No Custom Font Color
text: fonts-color-default · warning · static · default ✓ — Ensures no inline color styles are applied. Custom colors can break accessibility contrast requirements and visual consistency.

heading: No Copy-Paste Artifacts
text: word-paste-artifacts · error · static · default ✓ — Detects leftover markup from pasting content out of Word, Office, or AI tools. Catches mso- styles, Mso classes, tags, tags, and AI-generated data attributes like data-start and data-end.

heading: Transcript Present
text: transcripts-present · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that every video has an associated transcript file. Transcripts are required for accessibility and aid comprehension.

heading: Transcript Downloadable
text: transcripts-downloadable · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that transcripts have download_track set to true so learners can download them for offline use.

heading: Instructor Speaker Name
text: transcripts-instructor-speaker · warning · static · default ✓ — Checks that all transcripts use "INSTRUCTOR" as the speaker name for consistency across the course.

heading: Transcripts Not Empty
text: transcripts-not-empty · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures transcript SRT files contain real content (at least 10 lines) and are not empty or placeholder-only files.

heading: Resources Tab Exists
text: custom-pages-resources-exists · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that the course includes a Resources tab where learners can find supplemental materials.

heading: Glossary Tab Exists
text: custom-pages-glossary-exists · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that the course includes a Glossary tab defining key terms used throughout the course.

heading: Attributions Tab Exists
text: custom-pages-attributions-exists · warning · static · default ✓ — Checks for an Attributions tab that credits third-party content used in the course.

heading: Glossary Course Name
text: custom-pages-glossary-course-name · warning · static · default ✓ — Verifies that the glossary page references the correct course name, catching cases where a glossary was copied from another course.

heading: Video Present
text: video-present · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that every lecture and recitation vertical contains a video component. Missing videos indicate incomplete content.

heading: Video Downloadable
text: video-downloadable · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that videos have download_video set to true so learners can download them for offline viewing.

heading: Unique Video Name in Module
text: video-unique-name-in-module · warning · static · default ✓ — Flags two or more videos sharing the same display name within one module (chapter). Duplicate video names cause knowledge checks named after their video to collide.

heading: Learner Not Student
text: terms-learner-not-student · warning · static · default ✓ — Ensures inclusive language by checking that content uses "learner(s)" instead of "student", "user", or second-person "you".

heading: Acronym Plural Consistency
text: terms-acronym-consistency · info · ai · default ✓ — Uses AI to check that acronyms are pluralized consistently throughout the course (e.g., always "APIs" or always "API's", not a mix).

heading: Define Acronyms on First Use
text: text-acronym-first-use · warning · static · default ✓ — Flags an acronym used in HTML or problem text before it is defined. The first course-wide use should spell it out, e.g. "endoplasmic reticulum (ER)"; bare uses after that are fine. Widely understood acronyms (DNA, RNA, PCR, …) are exempt; extend the exemptions via params.allowAcronyms.

heading: Module Summary Exists
text: module-summary-exists · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that each module has a summary page providing a wrap-up of the module's content.

heading: Module Feedback Form Link
text: module-summary-has-survey-link · warning · static · default ✓ — Checks that the module summary includes a link whose text is "Module Feedback Form" so learners can share their experience.

heading: Dashboard Link Present
text: module-summary-has-dashboard-link · warning · static · default ✓ — Checks that the module summary includes a link back to the course dashboard for easy navigation.

heading: Image Alt Text
text: html-img-alt-text · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures every tag has a non-empty alt attribute so screen readers can describe images to visually impaired learners.

heading: No Empty Links
text: html-empty-links · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures every tag has visible link text or an aria-label so screen readers can describe the link's purpose.

heading: Math Notation Should Use MathJax
text: accessibility-math-mathjax · warning · static · default ✗ — Flags math/science notation authored as plain text or HTML that the accessibility team's screen-reader testing found needs MathJax to read correctly: caret exponents (x^2), scientific notation (2 × 10^-5), unicode and HTML super/subscripts including lone letters and charges (mⁿ, Cl- — screen readers don't announce the super/subscript; ordinals like "1st" are exempt), the multiplication sign × (read as the letter "x"), and symbols that only read aloud in MathJax. Only fires outside existing MathJax. Does not flag standalone Greek letters, temperature degrees, or relational operators (≤ ≥ ≠ ±), which read correctly in HTML. Plain-text chemical formulas/ions (H2O, Mg2+) are flagged only when params.flagChemistry is true (element-symbol validated to limit noise). Extend the MathJax-only symbol list via params.specialSymbols.

heading: Chapters Have Content
text: chapter-has-content · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that every chapter contains at least one sequential (subsection). Empty chapters indicate incomplete course structure.

heading: Sequential Ordering Consistent
text: sequential-ordering-consistency · warning · static · default ✓ — Checks that subsections within each chapter follow consistent numbering without unexpected gaps.

heading: Draft Content Warning
text: structure-has-drafts · info · static · default ✓ — Reports drafts in the drafts/ directory that are genuinely unpublished — new content with no published counterpart, or drafts whose content differs from the published version. Stale drafts identical to published content (common after re-runs and imports) are ignored.

heading: Slide Link Format
text: pdf-slides-link-format · warning · static · default ✓ — Checks that slide download link text is a label naming the deck and ends with "(PDF)", e.g. "Lecture 1.1 (PDF)". Texts like "PDF version" or a bare "(PDF)" don't qualify.

heading: Slide Link Separate Component
text: pdf-slides-separate-component · warning · static · default ✓ — Verifies that the slide download link is placed in its own HTML component directly below the video, not embedded in other content.

heading: Static File Links Valid
text: html-broken-static-links · error · static · default ✓ — Verifies that all links pointing to /static/ files actually reference files that exist in the course export.

heading: Video Has edX ID
text: video-missing-edx-id · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures every video component has a non-empty edxVideoId. Missing IDs mean the video won't play on the platform.

heading: No Paragraphs in List Items
text: lists-no-p-in-li · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures list items do not contain nested tags, which cause extra spacing and inconsistent rendering across browsers.

heading: Use Strong for Bold
text: bolding-use-strong · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures bold text uses semantic tags instead of deprecated tags or inline font-weight styles, improving accessibility and consistency.

heading: H4 in Overview/Summary
text: headings-h4-overview-summary · error · static · default ✓ — Ensures section headers in overview and summary pages use tags to maintain a consistent heading hierarchy across the course.

heading: AskTIM Chat Enabled
text: asktim-present · warning · static · default ✓ — Checks that the AskTIM AI chat assistant is enabled on relevant content blocks via OL_OPENEDX_CHAT settings, giving learners on-demand help.

heading: Summary Bolding Standards
text: summaries-bolding-standards · info · static · default ✓ — Checks that bold formatting in summary takeaways follows course standards, using tags consistently for key terms.
